nodes.description: Public uint256 counter tracking how many wedding messages were created; used as the index key for the mappings and incremented on each createWeedingMessage call.
Private mapping(uint256 => string) holding the message text indexed by message number.
Private mapping(uint256 => string) holding the author/assistant name indexed by message number.
Private address set in the constructor from msg.sender; acts as the access-control guard for cashback.
Constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender at deployment time.
Public payable function that stores the author into _assistant and the message into _wedMessages under the current amountOfMessages index, then increments the counter.
Public view function returning (_assistant[tokenId], _wedMessages[tokenId]) for a caller-supplied tokenId.
Function requiring msg.sender == owner and then transferring the entire contract balance to msg.sender.
Caller-controlled address; becomes owner in the constructor and is the destination of the cashback balance transfer.
External value transfer payable(address(msg.sender)).transfer(address(this).balance) that sends the full contract balance to the caller.
Arithmetic increment of the message counter performed on every createWeedingMessage call.
Author name string parameter of createWeedingMessage.
Message text string parameter of createWeedingMessage.
Lookup key uint256 parameter of getWedMessage.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable in the constructor, so the caller controls the privileged owner role.
The constructor assigns owner from the untrusted caller address, establishing the access-control principal.
cashback gates its body on require(msg.sender == owner), so the untrusted caller address determines whether the privileged branch executes.
cashback executes the external balance transfer, giving an untrusted recipient execution control during the function.
The external transfer to msg.sender can re-enter cashback (or other contract entry points) before the function completes.
The untrusted msg.sender value flows directly into the destination address of the balance transfer.
createWeedingMessage performs the counter increment amountOfMessages + 1.
The result of the arithmetic increment is written back into the amountOfMessages state variable.
createWeedingMessage reads amountOfMessages as the index for both mapping writes.
The iAm parameter is stored into the _assistant mapping under the current message index.
The message parameter is stored into the _wedMessages mapping under the current message index.
createWeedingMessage writes the submitted message text into the _wedMessages state mapping.
createWeedingMessage writes the submitted author name into the _assistant state mapping.
The tokenId parameter is consumed by getWedMessage as the lookup key.
getWedMessage reads message text out of the _wedMessages state mapping.
getWedMessage reads the author name out of the _assistant state mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: iAm is a non-core parameter whose only use is being written into _assistant inside createWeedingMessage; it should be folded into that core function node.
message is a non-core parameter whose only use is being written into _wedMessages inside createWeedingMessage; it should be folded into that core function node.
tokenId is a non-core parameter used solely as the lookup key in getWedMessage; it should be folded into that core function node.
